pages.title: Movement and Axes
pages.text: Each of the 8 $(l:basics/spice_profiles)spice profile$() compound values will be mapped to the 8 movement directions. In essence, to move diagonally up-left, some of the $(axis:heat)Heat$() / $(axis:cooling)Cooling$() axis has to be spent. Even if one of the axes is used up, getting to a target cell in that direction is still possible in a roundabout way.

pages.title: Keyboard Movement
pages.text: If you don't want to click the movement buttons, you can instead use the keys $(code)$(k:key.forward)$(), $(code)$(k:key.left)$(), $(code)$(k:key.back)$() and $(code)$(k:key.right)$() to move around. Pressing two adjacent ones within a configurable timeout ($(code)100ms$() by default), you can also move diagonally. Pressing $(code)$(k:key.jump)$() locks in cells, and $(code)Escape$() and $(code)Enter$() can be used to close the GUI or confirm seasonings.
